evidence.note: Very large dark serif title on a plain white ground: high contrast, no hairlines.
Large soft blurred blue and faint grey blobs; no grain, texture or grid lines. The faintest grey blobs are near-invisible but purely decorative.
Mid-grey sans subtitle stays generously sized and readable at the small window.
Header nav and italic grey byline are the smallest text but remain dark enough to read; no faint microtext.

rationale: The slide uses big soft shapes and generous type with no hairlines, grain or texture, matching the pass anchor. The smallest text (nav, byline) stays legible at 1288x598, and the only elements compression might erase are decorative blurs that carry no content.
